'''Image Series AA-103-AJ-45''' was a series of images purportedly depicting the rise of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in ancient [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] cave paintings. They were made available for sale by [[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]].
